caption: The drawing depicts a wooden four-poster bed with a natural brown wood color and visible wood grain texture. The bed features four tall, turned posts, one at each corner, with rounded tops and decorative carved details near the tops and bottoms. The headboard and footboard are connected by horizontal panels, each with evenly spaced vertical spindles between two horizontal rails, and feature triangular, sloped top designs. The bed has a mattress covered by a white or cream-colored sheet, and a gathered, ruffled bed skirt or dust ruffle made from a similar white or cream fabric hangs down to the floor on all visible sides. The background is plain and uncolored, with only the bed as the focus of the composition. The artist's signature, "Fritz Boehmer," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Zoar Four-Post Bed
